newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Fuji Bank unit FRCD dealer group formed.
newsitem.headline: Fuji Bank unit FRCD dealer group formed.

text.p: A dealer group has been formed for Fuji Bank's HK$5 billion certificate of deposit programme via its Hong Kong branch, sole arranger Fuji International Finance Hong Kong said on Friday.
Under the programme, Fuji Bank could issue Hong Kong dollar fixed rate, floating rate or discounted certificates of deposit, Fuji International Finance said.
Hong Kong law was the governing law of the programme, and Hong Kong and Shanghai Banking Corp is programme agent.
A dealer group has been formed.
Fuji International Finance Hong Kong is the arranger.

Dealers are Chase Manhattan Asia, China Development Finance Co, Fuji International Finance Hong Kong, HSBC Markets, J.P. Morgan Securities Asia, Jardine Fleming Bank, Peregrine Fixed Income, Schroders Asia, Societe Generale Asia, Standard Chartered Bank, UBS, WestLB, Westpac Banking Corp Hong Kong, and Yamaichi International HK.
